state-v8.hex.notes: Byte-identical to state-v8-v6-envelope.hex: LedgerContractStateV8.deserialize(...).serialize() is a no-op round-trip on this input (see generators/mint-state-v8.mjs).

state-v8-v6-envelope.hex.notes: Ported verbatim from spike-dapp-hf/island-3/driver/tests/builder/fixtures/downcast-v8.hex (identical across islands 1/2/3 and ts-downcast). Raw compact-runtime-0.16 ContractState.serialize() output.

state-migrated-v9.hex.notes: Ported verbatim from spike-dapp-hf/island-3/driver/tests/builder/fixtures/migrated-v9.hex (identical across islands 1/2/3 and ts-downcast). A real ledger-8->9 migrated state, produced by the spike's Rust simulator's `migrate-8-to-9`.

state-migrated-v9-merkle.hex.notes: NOT a real migration output (ledger-v9 exposes no migrate/from_v8 entry point -- OQ9 mint-path (a) failed, and no small tree-bearing golden exists in the spike -- mint-path (b) failed for this one fixture only). Hand-built via ledger-v9's public StateBoundedMerkleTree/StateValue API: one rehashed leaf, so it deserializes cleanly with ledger-v9.

state-tampered-keyset-v8to9.hex.notes: state-v8-v6-envelope.hex with only the single ASCII version digit in the tag flipped '6'->'8' (see generators/mint-tampered-and-derived.mjs::swapVersionDigit). Declares v9-era schema, carries v8-era payload. Verified: both v8.ContractState.deserialize and v9.ContractState.deserialize throw.

state-tampered-keyset-v9to8.hex.notes: state-migrated-v9.hex with only the single ASCII version digit in the tag flipped '8'->'6'. Declares v8-era schema, carries v9-era payload. Verified: both v8.ContractState.deserialize and v9.ContractState.deserialize throw.

state-tampered-bytes.hex.notes: state-migrated-v9.hex with one payload byte XORed with 0xff at offset (tag-length + 32), tag left intact. Verified: v9.ContractState.deserialize throws ('out of range for u64').

state-both-keys.hex.notes: state-v8-v6-envelope.hex bytes followed immediately by state-migrated-v9.hex bytes -- both envelope tags present in one blob, so no single protocolVersion applies by construction. Verified: v8.ContractState.deserialize throws 'Not all bytes read...4692 bytes remaining' (full-buffer-consumption check catches the over-read); v9.ContractState.deserialize throws on the tag mismatch at offset 0.

state-co-v2-only-foreign.hex.notes: A4 mis-dispatch negative (fix round 1: reworked from a bare foreign ContractOperation, which failed at the envelope-tag check before ever reaching the intended code path). A full, well-formed ContractState (deserializes cleanly on ledger-v9, protocolVersion 2000000 to match) whose 'increment' operation slot carries the REAL 'post' operation borrowed from state-migrated-v9.hex -- a genuinely foreign, migrated op.v2-vintage verifier key, not built from twin-contract/. Fails only later, at execution (a verifier-key mismatch), never at decode. See README.md 'The A4 mis-dispatch fixture'.
